tags: 大衛帳幕的榮耀 10 主祢是我們的太陽
meta.author: 詞曲：羅嘉雁

lines.a: 祢呼召我 離開本地 我舒適的地方
lines.b: You called me to leave the place, where I am comfort

lines.a: 心中會軟弱 雙腳會顫抖 但祢賜我力量
lines.b: I am weak inside, my feet will tremble, but You strengthen me

lines.a: 我的生命 獻上在這祭壇上
lines.b: I already offer my life to You

lines.a: 預備自己 被祢擴張
祢的帶領 總是超乎我想像
lines.b: You guiding is always beyond my thoughts

lines.a: 我願順服 我願降服於祢
lines.b: I will obey, I will surrender to You

lines.a: 成為祝福 我願意獻上我生命
lines.b: Be a blessing, I am willing to offer my life

lines.a: 願祢滿足 我願意跟隨祢腳步
lines.b: To satisfy You, I am willing to follow You

lines.a: 成為祝福 我要一生頌讚祢名
lines.b: Be a blessing, Forever I will praise Your name

lines.a: 我願獻上所有 毫無保留
lines.b: I would like to offer all that I have

lines.a: 讓那地因我順服而得福
lines.b: Let the land be blessed 'cause I obey You

lines.a: 我願獻上所有 毫無保留
lines.b: I would like to offer all that I have

lines.a: 讓那地因我順服而得福
lines.b: Let the land be blessed 'cause I obey You
